verdicts.reason: A: the GLACIER wordmark is blown up and sits under the headline, so the brand reads as a second headline. The three flavour pills are spread out with big uneven gaps and different widths, and they're out of the original order (Blood Orange is now last). The headline is jammed against the left edge. B has the same wordmark-below-headline problem and the same reordered, unequal-width pills, and its headline almost touches the right edge. But the pills sit together as one block and the CTA is large and clear, so B is the less broken of the two.
